default_policy: Route by task type, evidence state, and risk level. Do not activate all skills for every request.

routes.when: Input contains raw material, claims, sources, or timeline uncertainty.
Input asks whether power, incentives, rules, paths, markets, or systems changed.
Input concerns public writing, self-media, audience path, offer, trust, conversion, or monetization.
routes.policy: Implement as original Mercury Method Lab skill. Do not import dbskill text, atoms, naming, or structure.

routes.when: A judgment needs concrete next steps, stop conditions, or acceptance criteria.
A conclusion can affect money, legal exposure, public trust, irreversible work, or project direction.
Approved artifacts should move into another memory architecture or upstream Mercury Agent runtime recall.
Work is prepared for GitHub, bilingual readers, or public practice guidance.
